name: Bethlehem
overview: Bethlehem, also known as Ephrath or Ephrathah, is a significant city southwest of Jerusalem mentioned in Scripture as the burial place of Rachel (Genesis 35:16, 19; 48:7). It is identified as the city of Boaz and the home of notable biblical figures such as Ibzan and a Levite from the family of Judah (Judges 12:10; 17:7). The city holds a central place in God's redemptive plan, being recognized as the birthplace of Jesus, underscoring its enduring spiritual importance.
